narrative:
FY2026 budget net operating income is EUR 216.8M, +9.4% on FY2025 actuals of EUR 198.3M. The Q3 forecast stands at EUR 211.2M — EUR 5.6M below budget. Most of the gap is rate, not volume: Euribor 12M resets on the Andorran mortgage book and reinvestment of maturing bonds at lower yields take EUR 4.0M out of retail and treasury income.

Fees are the offset. Net fees overtook net interest income in FY2025 (EUR 91.6M vs EUR 80.8M) and Tressis net new money is running 30% above budget. Asset Management & Investment Services is forecast at EUR 49.7M — EUR 0.7M above budget and the fastest-growing business line.

Key risk: fee income is now 46% of net operating income, so a 10% market correction would cost about EUR 9M of fees over 12 months.

signals.title: Q3 forecast €5.6M below budget
signals.excerpt: Net operating income €211.2M vs €216.8M budget: treasury −€2.2M, retail −€1.8M, private banking −€1.2M, corporate −€0.9M, asset management +€0.7M.

signals.title: Net interest income down 6.6% as rates fall
signals.excerpt: Interest income fell from €102.3M to €95.9M; NII from €86.5M to €80.8M while loans grew 13.5% to €1.72Bn.

signals.title: Net fees now exceed net interest income
signals.excerpt: Net fees €91.6M vs NII €80.8M; gross fees +33% to €132.9M with Tressis and the Spanish bank in the perimeter.
